title: 4 x Meross Matter Smart Wi-Fi Plug with Energy Monitoring. $34.59 USD Delivered. (~ $48.25 AUD) @Meross AliExpress
body:
Deal: 4 x Meross Matter Smart Wi-Fi Plug with Energy Monitoring. $34.59 USD Delivered. (~ $48.25 AUD) @Meross AliExpress

[JimmyBargain] Now it's $AU38.92 for 4 units. and $AU16.56 for 2 units and on top of that you can get $5 off for spending $AU25
[Dollar Dreamer] Some are getting qualified for $6 discount code instead of the usual $3 discount code. Doesn't work for everyone but if you are lucky and also have coins to discount the price further, great.
[Scanlia] Note, it looks like these are Matter over WiFi , not Matter over Thread , if that matters to you!
[intrepidswashbucker] Got a bunch of these averaging $8/ea — a few WiFi problems, almost bricked one, I think one is DoA, but major benefit is they don’t impede the second socket on a dual GPO
IKEA ones have been way more trustworthy for me but I’ll use the ones I have until they don’t work anymore
[Dollar Dreamer] My experience was the opposite, returned 3 Ikea ones due to spotty connections. Got the Meross, using them for 1 year now, rock solid.
[intrepidswashbucker] I might just be lucky in that case — the purpose of the IKEA ones in our house is to extend the mesh, no such luck with these ones though they were fairly reliable until I tried to move everything over to an IoT only VLAN — long story short, when the app offers you to move multiple devices to a new WiFi, don’t do it — do them all individually
[nov1911] what protocol were they?
ikea matter products have been horrible, wifi ok, zigbee perfect
[S Baldrick] One of mine was being used for energy monitoring on my servers, and seemed to reboot every few weeks randomly. The dropouts started increasing in frequency eventually, so I had to decomission it.
The one used for my gaming PC (which draws more power) hasn't had any issues.
Both were connected directly to a powerpoint on the wall - with an extension lead connected to a power board (yes, I know) for the faulty one, and a power board connected directly to the working one.
[Jackson] I still have the old wifi ones, but for my purposes it really doesn't matter
[ck16] Looks like I just got in on time and bought the last 4 pack. They’re now out of stock.
Only the double pack is available for order.
[messmorph] Anyone know any thread and matter smart plugs with energy monitoring?
